basics.name: Xiangyu Li
basics.summary: PhD student at HKUST(GZ) working on autonomous driving systems, perception and localization, end-to-end driving models, and system-level evaluation using large-scale real-world driving datasets.

work.company: KITE Lab, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
work.summary: Built the PAVE Dataset for production autonomous vehicle evaluation.
highlights: Integrated camera, GNSS/RTK, IMU, and CAN bus data collected in naturalistic driving environments.
Supported dataset design distinguishing autonomous driving and manual driving modes.

work.company: School of Computing, University of Leeds
work.summary: Worked on autonomous robots for inspection and mapping in underground pipe networks.
highlights: Designed autonomous navigation and topological mapping algorithms.
Worked with ROS, Linux, Gazebo simulation, embedded systems, and multi-sensor integration.
